# tebib_iam_role (Resource)

An IAM role: a set of permissions that trusted principals assume for a short session. Give it permissions with `tebib_iam_policy_attachment`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_iam_role" "deploy" {
  name = "deploy"
  trust_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2026-10-08"
    Statement = [{
      Effect    = "Allow"
      Principal = { Tebib = tebib_iam_service_account.ci.trn }
      Action    = "iam:AssumeRole"
    }]
  })
  max_session_seconds = 3600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (1-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 +=,.@_-). Changing it replaces the role.
- `trust_policy` (String) Who may assume the role: a JSON policy document, e.g. from `jsonencode()`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 1000 characters. Default: empty.
- `max_session_seconds` (Number) Longest session, 900-43200 seconds. Default: 3600.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID (`o-...`). Default: the provider's `organization`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Role ID (`role-...`).
- `trn` (String) TRN, the `principal` of policy attachments.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import tebib_iam_role.deploy role-abc123
```
